name: George Gordon Byron
original_name: ジョージ・ゴードン・バイロン
source:
Over 600 years old vampire, one of Blue Bloods and ruler of western europe vampire community.

Eccentric and decadent, believes herself to be above any law. Her sudden appearance in Foggybottom brings in a lot of confusion.
